meta.name: ecommerce-copywriter
meta.description: 电商图片文案创作技能，支持多品类产品的吸引性文案生成，适用于电商平台的商品营销推广

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 为电商商品生成吸引人的营销文案
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要为电商产品快速撰写吸引眼球的文案
copy.tagline_en: Generate compelling marketing copy for ecommerce products
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly write eye-catching copy for ecommerce products

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会为电商商品创作图片文案：先收集产品名称、卖点、目标用户等信息，从模板库挑选对应品类，按固定结构写标题和正文，并适度使用 emoji；同时也能对已有文案的标题、正文和 emoji 进行优化。
howto.when: 当用户提出电商文案创作需求、文案优化需求，或要求为电商商品生成营销文案时触发。具体需提供产品信息，Claude 会判断品类并执行。

say.text: 帮我写一款智能眼罩的电商文案，卖点是科学遮光和智能感应光线。
say.note: Claude 会收集信息并按模板产出完整文案。

say.text: 优化这段充电宝文案，标题和正文都改改。
say.note: Claude 会改进标题、卖点和 emoji 使用。

say.text: 给这款可降解餐具写推广文案，强调环保与健康。

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude creates ecommerce image copy: it gathers product details, picks a category template, writes headlines and body in a fixed structure, and uses emojis moderately. It can also refine existing copy's headline, body, and emojis.
howto.when_en: It triggers when users request ecommerce copy creation or optimization, or ask for marketing copy for products. Claude then requests product info and follows the template workflow.

say_en.text: Write an ecommerce ad for a smart sleep mask, highlighting light-blocking and light sensing.
say_en.note: Claude gathers info and outputs a full copy.

say_en.text: Optimize this power bank copy, improve the headline and main text.
say_en.note: Claude revises the title, benefits, and emoji.

say_en.text: Create promotional copy for these biodegradable utensils, stressing eco-friendliness.
say_en.note: Claude outputs a Markdown copy with headline and four paragraphs.
